name: fullstack
description: Full-stack web app: React 18 + Vite + TypeScript frontend, Python 3.13+ FastAPI backend, AWS deployment
constitution_principles: Frontend components never import directly from backend modules; all data crosses the API boundary via HTTP.
FastAPI route handlers in backend/api/ are thin wrappers only — validate input, call a service in backend/core/, return a response. No business logic in route handlers.
Server state lives in React Query. Local UI state lives in Zustand or useState. Never duplicate server state in the client store.
Pydantic models define the API contract. Zod schemas on the frontend mirror them. When either changes, the other changes in the same commit.
Secrets are never committed. Use .env for local development and SSM Parameter Store for production.

starter_rules.prevents: business logic leaking into FastAPI route handlers
triggers: route handler file contains database queries, non-trivial computation, or domain logic
plan or implementation adds logic directly inside a route function instead of a service
starter_rules.rule: FastAPI route handlers in `backend/api/` are thin wrappers only: validate input, call a function in `backend/core/`, return a response. Business logic belongs in `backend/core/`.
starter_rules.detection_pattern: Review edits under `backend/api/` for direct DB queries, non-trivial computation, or logic that belongs in a service or core module.
starter_rules.correct_pattern: Route handler delegates to `backend/core/`. The core function owns the logic and is independently testable.

starter_rules.prevents: server state duplicated or manually synced in client-side store
triggers: Zustand store is created for data that originates from an API endpoint
frontend code manually copies or syncs server response data into a local store
starter_rules.rule: Use React Query for all server state (fetching, caching, mutations). Use Zustand only for UI-only state that does not come from the server (sidebar open, modal visibility, user preferences not persisted remotely).
starter_rules.detection_pattern: Review Zustand store definitions for fields that mirror API response shapes or that are populated by fetch or mutation callbacks.
starter_rules.correct_pattern: API data lives in a React Query query or mutation result. Components call `useQuery` or `useMutation`. Data is never copied into a Zustand store.

starter_rules.prevents: frontend and backend drifting from the agreed data contract
triggers: Pydantic response model is changed without a corresponding Zod schema update
frontend TypeScript type is defined manually without referencing or mirroring the API contract
starter_rules.rule: Pydantic models in `backend/api/` define the API contract. Zod schemas on the frontend must mirror them. Both sides must change in the same commit when the contract changes.
starter_rules.detection_pattern: Review backend Pydantic model changes for a matching frontend Zod schema update in the same diff, and vice versa.
starter_rules.correct_pattern: Change Pydantic model and Zod schema together. If openapi-typescript or similar generation is configured, regenerate and commit the output.
